subject: Human Body
title: The Liver: Body's Chemical Factory
description: A fast breakdown of The Liver: Body's Chemical Factory for builders.

hook.text: Your liver performs over 500 functions. It's the largest internal organ and you can't live without it.

buildup.text: It filters all blood from the gut, detoxifies chemicals, metabolizes drugs, and produces bile for fat digestion.

discovery.text: The liver stores glucose as glycogen and releases it when blood sugar drops. It's your energy buffer.

twist.text: The liver can regenerate. Lose 75% and it grows back to full size within weeks. No other organ does this.

climax.text: The liver is a detoxifier, warehouse, and factory rolled into one. It touches nearly every metabolic process.

punchline.text: Five hundred jobs, one organ, and it can regrow itself.

quiz.question: What unique ability does the liver have among organs?
options: It can function without blood supply
It can regenerate after losing up to 75%
It produces red blood cells in adults
